name: 19672-batchdecode-235ba22b-tp8
parallelism: TP=8, EP=1 (expert parallelism off), PP=1, DP=1. One node, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: Qwen3MoeForCausalLM, 94 decoder layers, hidden 4096, 64 attention heads over 4 KV heads at head_dim 128, 128 routed experts with top-8 routing, moe_intermediate_size 1536, vocab 151936, bf16; ~470 GB of safetensors, ~54.7 GiB per card at TP8.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup the first 10%, bounded at 1024 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no prefix buckets and no prefix reuse: 1024 prompt tokens in, 1024 generated out, both FIXED (stdev 0), `ignore_eos: true`, `max_tokens: 1024`, `temperature: 0.0`, seed 42.
purpose: A large mixture-of-experts chat assistant handling 64 concurrent single-turn requests, 1K in and 1K out, on eight GPUs.
launch:
# The sglang server arguments this item is launched with. Host, port and served-model-name are
# set by whatever starts the server; everything not listed here is a stock default.
model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507
tp-size: 8
chunked-prefill-size: 16384
context-length: 131072
max-running-requests: 256
decode-attention-backend: flashinfer
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
cuda-graph-max-bs: 64
disable-radix-cache: true
